digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, LLM step failure tracking
propositions: Repeated non-fatal LLM step failures (e.g. overlap-judge batch calls) complete the run and produce a verdict but remain invisible in the output JSON, leaving failed work indistinguishable from successful non-matching results

Failed LLM calls funnel through a single seam (PydanticAIRunner.run exception handler) which records to a spend log but not to the in-memory verdict object, and ~13 swallow sites log warnings but no structured failure count
The plan-review verdict coverage object lacks a counter for survived step failures; coverage.resolution_class fires only on fatal degradation and coverage.chunk_errors is write-only with no reader

A new run-scoped contextvars sink (step_failures.py) records failures at the runner seam, is activated in the plan-review run scope, and drains into coverage.llm_step_failures only when non-empty to preserve attestation safety
The failure count must not alter verdict, exit code, signature, or swallow behaviour; it is observability only and surfaces per-step failure tallies keyed by _call_label for operator debugging
